<place>
Mahawewa Canal (set).
</place>

<people>
- Aruni: on_screen
- Nimal: body
</people>

Blocks 0 to 7:
<script>
[0] action: Heavy rain. Aruni walks beside a paddy field carrying a small medical bag. She notices something caught near the canal gate: a body. It is Nimal.
[1] action: She does not scream. She kneels and touches his hand.
[2] action: Inside his fist is a small metal key marked C-17.
[3] dialogue Aruni, on_screen: Dinu... oyata meka ahenne nadda?
[4] action: She calls Dinu. No answer.
[5] sound: A distant bus horn mixes with the rain.
[6] transition: Cut to black.
[7] text: TITLE: EKAMA SAKSHIYA.
</script>
